minutes.headline: Zoning board approved a side-setback and height special permit for a 25x25 addition at 101 White Street, on one condition.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard the Roberts Mahoney petition for a 25 by 25 foot addition at 101 White Street that needs side setback and height relief. The board asked about roof height, the septic distance, the fence and a plot plan disclaimer. After a supportive neighbor spoke, the board approved the permit by roll call, conditioned on the secretary confirming the plot plan with the surveyor.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals approved a special permit for side-setback and height relief for an addition at 101 White Street, by roll call.
Approval is conditioned on the secretary confirming with the surveyor's firm what the plot plan disclaimer means and that the setbacks are accurate.
The board questioned the applicant on roof height, septic distance, the fence and the plot plan disclaimer before voting.
One neighbor spoke in public comment and stated no objection to the plan.
The next hearing was set for two weeks from the meeting night.

why_it_matters: Setback and height relief changes what can be built close to a neighbor's lot, and the permit's condition on the surveyor's confirmation decides whether the approved setbacks hold up on the ground.
watch_next: The secretary's confirmation with the surveyor on the plot plan disclaimer and setbacks, which the permit depends on.
